pages.text: $(bold)Diary fragment:$()"Akaishi Crystals are merely sleeping fuel. Feed them to the Purifier and the 'force' truly awakens - we call it$(2) Chi Energy$()."$(br2)Chi Energy is the blood of Akaishi technology: the Purifier produces and consumes it, Energy Cells hoard it, and Energy Pipes deliver it to every machine.

This chapter covers:$(li)Akaishi Purifier: the first Chi machine$(li)Energy Cell: the energy warehouse$(li)Energy Pipe: the energy artery$(li)Speed upgrades and multi-blocks: large-scale generation and refining$(br2)Every machine in later chapters runs on Chi Energy - build this foundation first.
